text.en: Pet owners consistently compliment the store staff for their approachable attitude and practical advice. Reviewers note that team members are helpful over the phone, greet visiting pets warmly by name, and display genuine patience when fitting harnesses on anxious dogs.

Shoppers find the store inside the Lidl Complex on Main Road clean, accessible, and inviting. While most customers highlight a strong range of toys and dog foods, one visitor noted that specialty kitten food selections were more limited in-store than shown on the website.

The store receives positive remarks for accommodating a wide range of family companions, including dogs, aquarium fish, and small animals. Reviewers appreciate that the premises welcome pets indoors and provide a calm atmosphere where nervous dogs feel reassured.

q.en: Are dogs permitted inside the Tallaght store?

a.en: Yes, the shop is pet-friendly and welcomes dogs to visit and try on harnesses with the staff.
The store is located at Unit 5 in the Lidl Complex on Main Road in Tallaght, Dublin 24.

q.en: Does the store offer multi-buy discounts?

a.en: Yes, customers note regular promotional offers such as three-for-two deals across various foods and treats.

q.en: Are fish and aquatic supplies available here?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm purchasing goldfish and aquarium necessities directly at the Tallaght store.
